newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO to pay $1.9 billion for SFB.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO to pay $1.9 billion for SFB.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO Holding NV said Friday it would offer $1.9 billion to acquire Standard Federal Bank, the seventh-largest savings bank in the United States and the biggest in Michigan.
ABN AMRO said it was offering $59 a share for Standard Federal, a bank holding company with $15.5 billion in assets based in Troy, Mich.
Standard Federal Bank, a large home mortgage lender in Michigan, currently operates about 180 banking centers and 11 home lending centers. It also operates a wholesale mortgage banking business.
Trading in SFB's stock on the New York Stock Exchange was halted Thursday afternoon after the Chicago Tribune reported the proposed merger. It last traded at $58.
